programme.desc: The Buddy Badge. Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
programme.desc: Incy Wincy Spider. Hedgley sings a song about Incy Wincy Spider.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Golden Chicken and Lamp Post Walk. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers spot a golden chicken and cheer up a lamp post on a walk to pick vegetables!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted Goes Wild. Ted visits a wildlife park and helps look after the animals. He feeds the deer, gets a close-up look at a bison's gigantic tongue, and has a chat with a very noisy otter!

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Connor's Scottish Vegetarian Haggis. Connor makes a vegetarian haggis to share with his friends. He serves his haggis with neeps and tatties and has invited a bagpiper as a surprise.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures with Chantelle and Rory
programme.desc: Puffins. Rory and Sandy search for puffins. Chantelle joins an amazing young bird watcher.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Bandage Team. Therapy dog Sylvie and her owner, Katrina, visit the doctor's to help a little boy called Ben feel brave enough to see Dr Stevens about his grazed knee.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Snow Leopard and Yak. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them in the wild. This time, it's a snow leopard and some yaks.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle Make and Do. Doug helps Waffle make new neighbour Pepper a dog bed. They fondly remember when Mrs Hobbs adopted Pepper and when they made their first box-bed for her cat, George.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Spot the Puffin. Oona learns to love her colourful beak.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Yes Sir. Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this swinging homage to the Sinatra era, the Small Potatoes sing about how they are no average spuds.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Earning Your Stripes. A samba band is coming to play, and everyone is helping to prepare. Stripes is so busy that he has forgotten one thing - to book the band!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Future Badge. The Squirrels are transported into the future, where they encounter a robot version of Duggee as well as a few other interesting changes to the clubhouse.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Bee. Dee encourages a friend to say 'bee', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of different bees. There are stripy bees, buzzy bees, and yellow, black and fuzzy bees.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Capacity for Magic. Nine and friends learn that the amount of stuff that fits inside any container, tall or wide, is called capacity.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Mine. Educational fun. Alphablock I is having a dance party - by herself! Can her friends help her see the light on disco night?

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Flying Fun. Justin and his friends meet some very cool, feathered friends and learn to fly them. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is taking a trip on an aeroplane... but who is the pilot?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Twinkle Twinkle. Preschool fun from Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies are all sleeping - apart from Tinky Winky. Tinky Winky sees a star in the sky which sings Twinkle Twinkle.

programme.title: Patchwork Pals
programme.desc: Patchwork Rabbit. Patchwork Rabbit has a problem: he's invited everyone to his big circus, but they don't think it's big at all! Can Patchwork Rabbit save the show?

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Boing Boing. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa has got a new pogo stick and has a great time bouncing around.

programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: Action Chugger's Day Off. Action Chugger has a hard time relaxing.

programme.title: Gigglebiz
programme.desc: Episode 23. Comedy sketch show for younger viewers. Rapids Johnson enjoys an ice cream on his search for the Ice Cream Bear and Storybook Stan is distracted by some chewy toffees.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Sabre-Toothed Cat and Roar. Preschool series. Andy travels back in time to visit the sabre-toothed cat, but when his clock malfunctions, he is shrunk down to the size of an insect!

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: Where Is My Home? The Game Catchers arrive on the Underwater Planet and play follow the clue. They are interrupted by a lost turtle, who can't seem to find her way home.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Loggerhead Sea Turtle. Animated deep sea adventure series. When an underwater tremor separates the Gup-X and its crew, Barnacles seeks guidance from a mysterious sea turtle.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Stolen Firewood. Animated series. When Peter, Lily and Benjamin go out to collect firewood, they soon find that not one but three predators are after some too.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Philosophy Badge. The Squirrels think about life's big questions, helping Tino the Artistic Mouse escape a crisis of confidence and gaining their Philosophy Badges in the process.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Kipp's Dizzy Mystery. When Kipp doesn't know what made him giddy, it's up to Vida to solve the dizzy mystery.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Fortune Cookies. Evil Pea tricks Supertato and Broccoli with fake fortune cookies that tell them to leave the supermarket. Thankfully, Carrot doesn't believe them and saves the day.

programme.title: New: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Mission Harmony. Weasy and Spicy have to cover their ears when Sunny learns to play the guitar.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The Decider. The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Fishy Treasure Hunt. The Piris join a treasure hunt competition, but is Captain Krill all that he appears?

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: New: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and the Baby Triceratops. Andy discovers a lost baby triceratops with a thorn in its foot that needs his help.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard

programme.title: Clangers

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: Den. MeMo's den is not big enough for two. BaBa wants to build one they can both enjoy, so MeMo shows BaBa how. They build a den for the Yummies that's just right.
